title: FC 3313: Standpipes
officialText:
3313.1 Standpipe systems.

Standpipe systems for use at construction sites shall be provided, maintained, and made available for department use in accordance with this code, and the construction codes, including the Building Code.

3313.2 Demolition operations.

Where a building or structure with an existing standpipe system is being demolished, such system shall be maintained for the use of the department in accordance with the construction codes, including the Building Code.
